---
title: Manual imputation card contract
---

* Module: `miss_manual`; mutable pipeline card in Missing 2, before learned imputation.
* Proposal: one selected incomplete non-Target variable; deterministic missingness classifier, native predictor NaNs, max depth 1–5/default 3, minimum leaf fraction .02. All supported non-Target roles including Identifier participate. Exclude destination and shadow variables.
* Minimum leaf accuracy: slider .50–1.00, step .05, default .80. A leaf qualifies iff it predicts missingness (missing count strictly exceeds observed count) and missing/rows meets the threshold inclusively. Hide fields on other leaves and omit variables with no qualifying leaf from the navbar. Exclude hidden drafts from commits; settings changes do not silently alter committed rules. Preserve drafts when the threshold is raised and lowered. No qualifying leaves has an explicit empty state. Accuracy is descriptive leaf purity, not held-out accuracy.
* Types: bounded integers, finite floats, Boolean, unordered categories/string, datetime. Skip Ordered, Cyclic, geometry, list and complex objects. Empty supported variables allow unconditional manual rules.
* UI: variable Navset_bar following miss_type; HTML leaf panels and SVG connectors share coordinates, aligned terminal row and horizontal scrolling. Only leaves with missing destination cells show optional typed fields. Numeric controls and category/Boolean selectors; date picker with validated time entry. No expressions.
* Commit atomically validates and applies all current variable drafts, including inactive tabs. Preserve commitments with no current draft; reject the entire commit on any invalid enabled field. Reset clears committed rules and every draft, unchecks leaf fields and clears replacement entries on active and inactive tabs while retaining settings. Preserve drafts per proposal and bookmarks until reset. Depth changes never transfer decisions; upstream schema/data/role changes invalidate all decisions.
* Rule explanations: bold missing destination, replacement and when; one plain-language condition per line joined with and. Keep native missing/unseen routing in optional details. Singular/plural-aware status counts.
* Categorical choices and proposal encodings use observed nonmissing labels from the incoming pipeline preview, preserving categorical order; unused dtype levels are excluded. Capture reviewed levels in rules so fold-absent approved labels remain legal. Do not modify the upstream categorical schema.
* Parameters: JSON-safe rule list containing destination, kind, branch feature descriptors/vocabulary/threshold/side/native missing routing, replacement, and approved additional level. No fitted tree in exported configuration.
* Transformer: sklearn clone/pickle compatible, fit validates without learning, transform fills only missing destination cells. Use float32 split comparisons to match proposal trees. Unseen categories use missing routing. Evaluate all rules on original incoming values; reject overlapping assignments. Preserve observed cells, columns, index and dtypes; add only approved categorical replacements.
* Pipeline: append unfitted fixed transformer, full-data display-only preview, preserve earlier steps and clean frame. Repeat identical fixed rules in training and held-out transforms.
* Tests: healthcare/free, target exclusion/Identity inclusion, native routing/partition coverage/depth, dtype validation, optional leaves, all-missing root, category extension/fold-absent labels, simultaneous rules, clone/pickle/pipeline, browser commit/validation/drafts/reset/restoration/layout.
